name: mirage
text: Got all three; I wrote them down as CH81. (2) Kalshi: the engine was still running the old code. I reset it just now, a clean restart between scans, so it should pick up the fix that lists Kalshi bets. The first scan takes a few minutes. Then check the +EV tab with the Kalshi chip on. I'll look at the engine's Kalshi status myself and tell you what it shows. (1) Prices nobody sells at coming back: I'm tracing which path re-lists them. The fix I released covered the CNO list. The +EV list had an earlier one, so there must be a hole. (3) Matching for SX Bet and the other APIs: I'll audit it using the engine's own counts of lines it couldn't match, and fix what is wrong. I'll report what I find.
